list.metaDescription: TERWA's partner estates: selected properties, published with the same transparency. First partner: Château Coutet, Saint-Émilion Grand Cru.
list.title: The Estates
list.intro: TERWA selects exceptional estates and publishes each partnership with the same rigour: the place, the family, the parcels, the production and the prices, all verifiable. The cellar grows estate after estate.
list.featuredAlt: The David Beaulieu family in the vines of Château Coutet
list.featuredSummary: 400 years in the same family, zero chemicals since 1601, Peycocut terroir. Wine offered: Les Demoiselles, vintages 2025 to 2029.
list.upcomingDescription: In discussion. Each new estate will be announced with the same transparency.

estate.metaDescription: Château Coutet, Saint-Émilion Grand Cru: 400 years of family history, zero chemicals since 1601, the Peycocut terroir and the Les Demoiselles cuvée.
estate.heroIntro: The wine you pre-order comes from a very specific place, family and way of working. Here, in full transparency, is what you are buying.
estate.heroAlt: The three winegrowers of the David Beaulieu family in the vines of Château Coutet
estate.caption: Alain, Adrien and Matthieu David Beaulieu, three generations at the estate.
estate.terroirDescription: Les Demoiselles is born of 4 parcels in the Peycocut lieu-dit ("where the cuckoo sings", recorded as early as 1541), on the asteria limestone of the Saint-Martin plateau, the high point of the property, surrounded by premier cru neighbours. 2.7 hectares of vines around 100 years old, of which 1.5 hectares are reserved for TERWA pre-orders.
estate.terroirAlt: Map of the Peycocut parcels of the Les Demoiselles cuvée
estate.storagePre: The bottles are aged then held in bond at
estate.storageMid: (established by the Bordeaux CCI in 2009), insured by
estate.storagePost: , until they are made available. Each vintage can be delivered in an original 3-bottle wooden case.
estate.productionTitle: Ten years of production, in figures
estate.productionIntro: Figures provided by the property for the Les Demoiselles cuvée: volume produced and the price observed on the market today (source: Gute Weine Lobenberg, incl. tax, recorded on 2 July 2026), vintage by vintage.
estate.productionNote: Production varies from year to year: frosts, droughts and yields are part of the life of a vineyard worked without chemicals. If the harvest is insufficient for a given vintage, the pre-order is carried over to the following vintage.

family.detail: in the same family, the David Beaulieu, 14th generation, three generations at the estate today

chemistry.detail: no herbicide, pesticide or synthetic fertiliser since 1601, confirmed by independent laboratory analyses. Certified organic since 2012

estate.detail: in a single block, including 13 ha of vines, less than a kilometre from the medieval town of Saint-Émilion

horse.detail: ploughing with a draught horse to preserve the soils, fully manual harvest into small crates

genetics.detail: sélection massale with no clones, an exceptional genetic diversity (regional average: 2 genes/ha)

rating.detail: RVF 2026 and 100+/100 Lobenberg for the 2022 vintage of the Les Demoiselles cuvée
